subjects.label: Neri
subjects.summary: An imagined coastal archivist who leaves uncertainty visible in her tide notebooks.

value.premise: An archivist comparing incomplete accounts of an imaginary harbour.

value.motive: Keep uncertain records useful without making them certain.
value.contradiction: She longs for a complete chart and distrusts tidy explanations.
value.authorBackstory: Private drafting possibility: she may abandon the archive; undecided.

value.manner: Quiet, precise questions; room for disagreement.
value.signatureLine: There is a gap here. We can leave it visible.

value.privateNote: The lost ledger has no settled explanation.

entries.text: In this invented harbour, two painted lights mark a disused channel.
The ledger has an unfilled page. Its cause is deliberately unspecified.

instructions: Distinguish the invented harbour from real navigation advice.
Offer competing readings without declaring a missing event to have occurred.

examples.output: We do not know that it was torn out. Shall we compare the edges?

variants.text: Here is the little chart. The empty space is intentional.

value.alt: An abstract two-colour chart, not a portrait or usable navigation map.
